data.summary: Maintainer 'go; use cloudflare email routing' on 2026-10-07 for slice 1 of cms-first-013 (no gates): (1) scripts/cms-mirror.mjs: reads the live CMS pages (identity ladder as the sync), writes them into seed/seed.json (pages only; block types and collections stay as the repo says and schema drift is reported), and unless --check or --no-pr pushes a cms-edit/<timestamp> branch from origin/main and opens a PR 'CMS edit: ...' labelled cms-edit; --check exits 1 when the repo differs from the CMS and names the fixing command. (2) scripts/cms-sync.mjs becomes schema-only (block types create/update/activate; never writes page content; EmDash setup is the one-time bootstrap). (3) A Worker module triggered by a successful POST .../publish or .../unpublish on pages: after the response (waitUntil) it reads the live pages from D1, builds the seed, and through a GitHub fine-grained token (secret GITHUB_MIRROR_TOKEN, repo from a var) creates a branch, commit and PR with the cms-edit label; it never merges; on any failure it emails agent@smokyproduct.co (recipient from a var, sender mirror@repoglance.com) through a send_email binding with the page, the error and the npm run cms:mirror re-run; when the token or the email binding is absent it logs that it is unconfigured and does nothing else (dormant until slice 2). (4) src/namespace-gate.ts admits a machine identity (an Access JWT with common_name and no email, verified with jose against the team's JWKS and audience, carrying an EmDash Bearer token) only to GET on content and schema routes, PUT on a content entry whose JSON body carries a non-empty _rev and no status other than draft, POST create with status draft, and POST .../preview-url; everything else answers 404; unit-tested. (5) scripts/live-check.mjs: a difference now means the repo is behind the CMS (run cms:mirror) and the live source is expected to be cms. (6) .github/workflows/cms-edit-automerge.yml arms auto-merge (merge commit) for cms-edit PRs on cms-edit/* branches with the repository token. (7) Docs: AGENTS.md boundaries (CMS owns content, repo owns structure, agents draft only, the mirror), docs/cms-access.md runbook, README, docs/content.md, docs/getting-started.md; wrangler.jsonc declares the send_email binding and the vars; prepare-deploy passes them through; jose pinned as a direct dependency. (8) Proof under proof/cms-first-20261007/PROOF.md and .grilltrack/proof/cms-first-013-verify-20261007.md: unit tests, npm run verify, a dev-server round trip (bootstrap, an admin-style publish, mirror --check and --no-pr showing the edit, the Worker trigger against a local GitHub stub), a separate read-only review on the exact commit, commit with the trailer, push, PR against main. Slice 2 (gates, maintainer): the GitHub token secret, repo auto-merge on, a ruleset on main requiring the site checks, Email Routing on repoglance.com with agent@smokyproduct.co verified and the send_email binding, deploy, one real edit and one forced failure. Slice 3 (gates, later): the agent draft lane. No merge, deploy, Cloudflare, DNS, Access or secret action by the agent.

data.summary: Maintainer 'agree on all; lock it and spawn the session' on 2026-10-07 after a frontier batch grilled against WooCommerce.
